mainText: <speak><voice name="Salli">Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, the skies are clear over Badger Prairie County Park with the full moon shining bright. There are no visible ISS passes tonight. The temperature is 81 degrees, and we expect an overnight low of 69 degrees with no rain predicted.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Matthew">In city news, the Verona Senior Center is offering a tri-shaw bike program that requires a signed waiver to participate, and the City Clerk is hosting an I Voted sticker design contest for students that is open for community voting through August 7.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Matthew">There is a lot happening in the community, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's, and mark your calendars for the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market this Wednesday.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Joanna">In the weekly police report, we noted an incident from July 23 where a 23 year old Verona man was arrested for disorderly conduct and O W I related intimidation of a victim.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Kimberly">Today's delicious flavor of the day is Snickers Swirl. The shop is currently closed, but they will open at 10 AM tomorrow, when the flavor of the day will switch to Georgia Peach.</voice></speak>
